about:
Stoba USA Corporation is based in Charleston, South Carolina, and operates as the U.S. entity of the global Stoba Group, a German-headquartered technology partner for precision components and systems. The founding year of the U.S. subsidiary is not publicly disclosed; the parent company traces its roots to decades of experience in precision engineering and special machine building. Ownership details for the U.S. entity are not specified in available sources.

The company develops, produces, and assembles high-precision metal components and hybrid systems, covering processes such as milling, drilling, hard and fine machining, laser processing, electrochemical machining (ECM/PECM), turning, sheet metal fabrication, cleaning, measuring and testing, and final assembly. Stoba also designs and builds custom tooling, fixtures, and production equipment to realize complex parts. The group serves prototype through large-series volumes across its facilities in Germany, China, and the United States, supported by in-house engineering for software, hardware, and mechanics.

Stoba’s customer base spans commercial vehicles, semiconductors, agricultural and construction machinery, maritime, passenger cars, e-mobility, micro-mobility, consumer goods, industrial applications, aerospace, security and defense, and medical and laboratory sectors. The company emphasizes simultaneous engineering to industrialize challenging components that conventional methods cannot address.

Stoba differentiates itself through interdisciplinary expertise combining precision technology and special machine building, a focus on innovation and process development, and a global service network offering worldwide support from development through series production.
